verdict.rationale: Codegen provides multiple surfaces to interact with an in-progress agent — CLI (view/pull agent work, TUI for browsing runs), API (resume-agent-run, list-agent-runs, agent run logs), Slack notifications/clarification requests, and PR/branch review in GitHub — suggesting a developer could redirect or continue a task from several environments. However, there's no explicit documentation of a live 'takeover' UX (e.g., pausing mid-task in an editor and injecting new instructions interactively) or an editor/IDE extension for real-time handoff; the resume endpoint implies pause/resume but not fine-grained redirection. missing for 10: explicit editor-integrated takeover flow, documented mid-task redirection UX, independent/hands-on confirmation of seamless handoff across editor/terminal/browser.
